description:
Classify the fz-rh2.9 no-fail mismatch set plus the fz-rh2.16.3 newly-running allocation mismatch: append, bsx_guard_eq, enum_list_allocations, enum_reduce_suspend, enum_sort, filter, process_heap_stats, quicksort, reverse, tree.

Most are allocation-stat or path-specific golden questions; choose explicit expected.fz2-run/interp/build files where the behavior is correct but the allocation contract differs. bsx_guard_eq needs a semantic check because fz2 interp selects a different branch. enum_reduce_suspend now runs through fz2 run/interp/build, but fz2 native allocates additional closure/scalar boxes versus the old native golden, so it needs an explicit fz2 allocation contract before matrix promotion.

Signal: each fixture either has fz2 matrix paths with intentional fz2 goldens, a bug ticket for a semantic mismatch, or a documented out-of-scope reason.

comments.text:
Golden pass on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership (commits 417d4c2b0, e391791d5).

RESOLVED (goldens refreshed, verified field-by-field — program output byte-identical, no heap field increased):
- append, filter, reverse, quicksort: diffs were stale scheduler counters (reductions_remaining + yield counters; confirmed deterministic across repeated runs) plus reverse-interp cons_allocs 10->5 (owned-cons reuse improvement landing in the interpreter's measured output). quicksort additionally hit its 11-cons native target (417d4c2b0) and now has the canonical expected.txt.

RECLASSIFIED — NOT golden choices; real behavior regressions, must NOT be blessed (proven pre-existing vs parent commit ca703c6b7, so not caused by the cons-reuse arc):
- tree: scalar_box_allocs 0->14, allocs 3->17, AND lost its type/no-matching-clause warning (the diagnostic that closed fz-rh2.11.8).
- case_tuple_pattern_sequential: lost its case_clause fall-through diagnostics.
- enum_list_allocations: an allocation slot increased (3->15).
These belong with the lost-exhaustiveness-diagnostics regression tracked under fz-9i4.7, not a golden decision.

STILL OPEN here:
- bsx_guard_eq: interp selects a different branch (matches this ticket's existing note) — semantic check still needed.
- enum_sort: telemetry pin is now stale-LOW (runtime reuse 1->132 after 417d4c2b0) and interp mismatches; pin needs updating to the improved numbers.

Folded at 2479a69fd (audit-clean; commit-message +1->-1 direction corrected at fold). Adversarial audit verified EVERY rebless LEGITIMATE by running fixtures live + byte-diffing: append/quicksort/reverse are single-line reductions_remaining-only drift (emit_back_edge_yield_check codegen-shape counter, not semantics/allocs); enum_sort/enum_reduce_suspend/enum_list_allocations-interp goldens match live output exactly; the enum_sort static pin rebaselined to the honest current value (15/21/15/15 -> 14/20/14/14, runtime reuse unchanged 132/132); deleted expected.repl/jit/aot/fz2-* sidecars confirmed never read by the harness (only expected.<run|interp|build>.txt); bsx_guard_eq verified :guard_hit on both paths (already fixed by fz-bin.11). Matrix 18->11 red. All 10 fixtures dispositioned: append/quicksort/reverse/enum_sort/enum_reduce_suspend/filter/process_heap_stats/bsx_guard_eq -> fz2 goldens/green; enum_list_allocations interp green, run/build honestly LEFT RED (real native regression, not blessed); tree deferred vs fz-9i4.7.1. lib 1248/0/6. Two audit follow-ups filed: fz-6jh (enum_list_allocations native scalar_box 3->15 regression) + fz-myo (reductions_remaining upward creep, 2nd rebless of same symptom -> root-cause not rebless again).
